technical.summary: ABBV shows intermediate-term bullish structure (long EMA alignment, trend confirmation) but lacks short-term momentum confirmation; MACD bearish divergence and overbought stochRSI create entry risk despite price strength above key moving averages.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 74 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear market sentiment presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional buying from junior member provides minimal conviction support; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (39.5), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising USD pressures multinational earnings, with earnings event 74 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Intermediate-term bullish structure (price above 200-EMA, EMA 50/200 aligned, supertrend/PSAR bullish) with extreme fear sentiment creating contrarian opportunity near support level 131.52.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical macro headwinds (VIX crisis 39.5, flat yield curve, rising USD), severe momentum divergence (MACD bearish, stochRSI overbought, AO negative), weak fundamentals (zero insider activity, high earnings risk in 74 days), and insufficient short-term confirmation outweigh long-term structure.

decision.entry_rationale: While ABBV shows intermediate-term bullish structure (price above 200-EMA, supertrend confirmation) and extreme fear sentiment creates contrarian opportunity, critical macro headwinds and severe momentum divergence create unfavorable risk/reward at current levels.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment (39.5) combined with flat yield curve recession signal and MACD bearish divergence could trigger sharp reversal despite technical support at 131.52.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical bullish but fundamental/risk/sentiment agents heavily weighted toward caution
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 15 Health Care positions with existing ABBV exposure; sector concentration and high volatility environment warrant avoiding additional capital deployment in this ticker.
